from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,re,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path.cwd(); PROD=Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod'
DEMO='control/dev_checks/project_executor_demo_e001.py'
INTENDED=[
 'control/codex_supervisor/build_planner.py',
 'tests/control/test_build_planner_nonbuildable_components.py',
 'tests/control/test_build_planner_retry.py',
 'knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json',
]
ALLOWED_PREFIXES=('control/','tests/')

def git_prod(*args):
 cp=subprocess.run(['git',*args],cwd=PROD,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 assert cp.returncode==0, 'PROD_GIT_FAILED:'+str(args)+':'+cp.stdout[-1000:]
 return [x.strip() for x in cp.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]

def allowed(rel):
 if rel==DEMO: return False
 if rel.startswith('control/project_tasks/') or rel.startswith('control/bridge_commands/inbox/'): return False
 if rel=='knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json': return True
 return rel.startswith(ALLOWED_PREFIXES)

# Mirror the current local source/test baseline into the isolated worktree only.
changed=set(git_prod('diff','--name-only','HEAD'))
untracked=set(git_prod('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'))
for rel in sorted(changed|untracked):
 if not allowed(rel): continue
 src=PROD/rel; dst=ROOT/rel
 if src.is_file():
  dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(src,dst)
 elif rel in changed and dst.exists() and dst.is_file():
  dst.unlink()

# Ensure the required current local files are present even if git status semantics change.
for rel in INTENDED:
 src=PROD/rel; dst=ROOT/rel
 assert src.is_file(), 'REQUIRED_LOCAL_FILE_MISSING:'+rel
 dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(src,dst)

planner=ROOT/INTENDED[0]
text=planner.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for marker in [
 'For REQUIRES_SHARED_INFRA or INSUFFICIENT_SPEC, components MUST be an empty list []',
 'NONBUILDABLE_COMPONENTS_MUST_BE_EMPTY',
 'BUILD_PLANNER_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED',
 'BUILD_PLANNER_COMPLETE_WITHOUT_STATE_ADVANCE',
]: assert marker in text, 'PLANNER_MARKER_MISSING:'+marker
new_sha=hashlib.sha256(planner.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

cfg=ROOT/INTENDED[3]
obj=json.loads(cfg.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
hex64=re.compile(r'^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$')
hits=[]
def walk(v,path=()):
 if isinstance(v,dict):
  for k,x in v.items():
   ks=str(k)
   if isinstance(x,str) and hex64.fullmatch(x) and 'build_planner' in ks.lower(): hits.append((v,k,x,path+(ks,)))
  mentions=any(isinstance(x,str) and 'build_planner.py' in x.lower() for x in v.values())
  if mentions:
   for k,x in v.items():
    if isinstance(x,str) and hex64.fullmatch(x) and str(k).lower() in {'sha256','source_sha256','hash','digest'}: hits.append((v,k,x,path+(str(k),)))
  for k,x in v.items():
   if isinstance(x,(dict,list)): walk(x,path+(str(k),))
 elif isinstance(v,list):
  for i,x in enumerate(v): walk(x,path+(str(i),))
walk(obj)
uniq=[]; seen=set()
for container,key,old,path in hits:
 sig=path
 if sig not in seen: seen.add(sig); uniq.append((container,key,old,path))
assert len(uniq)==1, 'BUILD_PLANNER_PIN_COUNT:'+str(len(uniq))
container,key,old,path=uniq[0]
assert old!=new_sha, 'BUILD_PLANNER_PIN_ALREADY_CURRENT'
container[key]=new_sha
cfg.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('AUTOBUILD_PREPARED')
print('PIN_PATH='+'/'.join(path))
print('PLANNER_SHA256='+new_sha)

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
want={'control/codex_supervisor/build_planner.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_nonbuildable_components.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_retry.py','knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json'}
cp=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=root,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert cp.returncode==0,'CACHED_DIFF_FAILED'
got={x.strip() for x in cp.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()}
assert got==want,'STAGED_SET_MISMATCH:'+repr(sorted(got))
print('STAGED_SET_EXACT')

notes: Direct generic autobuild build against the current local source/test baseline, reproduced read-only into an isolated ProjectExecutor worktree. Update only the build_planner pin, run targeted/runtime/full tests, diff-check, stage exactly the four intended autobuild files and commit locally. Production working tree/index is not written. No live/cost/wallet/credential/network actions; NO_PROVEN_EDGE unchanged.
